method.cut_sampling: Near faces, cloud action coordinates, envelope center and consecutive interval midpoints; before/after intact event assignments; both sides.
method.gravity: Original mapped self-weight point, unchanged; not a distributed physical gravity model.
method.high_side_sign: High-side physical cut traction is negated into the same on-low sign convention.
limits: Necessary normal-transfer bound for the saved point-action placement, not a physical tensile demand bound.
Zero does not give a retained-material pressure witness or a splitting pass.
Simultaneous shear, torsion and all moments remain in the wrench; the normal bound excludes shear/torsion capacity.
Finite sampling supplies no continuous maximum; positive counts are overlapping method records, not failed joints.
Existing bolt/capture actions are included once; no spare tie force, preload, reinforcement or host redistribution is credited.
Plywood leaves remain the admitted perfect-bond composites; no separate leaf/bond or panel/screw strength is assigned.
method.section_axes: [normal,p,q] is a right-handed cyclic permutation of [grain,u,v]; moments are about the cut datum
method.support: Whole finished analysis-BRep local bounding rectangle: a superset of each retained cut, including holes and taper.
